import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 262144;
    static final int MAXB = 20; // enough for up to 18 bits

    static int pwr(int x, int y, int Mo) {
        int z = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) != 0) z = (int)((long)z * x % Mo);
            x = (int)((long)x * x % Mo);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int m) {
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    int tmp = a[j + k + i] + a[j + k];
                    if (tmp >= Mo) tmp -= Mo;
                    a[j + k + i] = tmp;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void ifwt(int[] a, int m) {
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    int tmp = a[j + k + i] - a[j + k];
                    if (tmp < 0) tmp += Mo;
                    a[j + k + i] = tmp;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int L = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int Mo = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        int all = pwr(k, L, Mo);

        if ((L & 1) != 0) {
            System.out.println(all);
            return;
        }

        int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
        int[] inv = new int[MAXN];
        int[] cnt = new int[MAXN];
        int[][] f = new int[MAXB][MAXN];
        int[][] g = new int[MAXB][MAXN];

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % Mo) % Mo;
        }

        inv[L] = pwr(fac[L], Mo - 2, Mo);
        for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % Mo);
        }

        // cnt[i] = popcount(i)
        cnt[0] = 0;
        for (int s = 1; s <= L; s++) {
            cnt[s] = cnt[s ^ (s & -s)] + 1;
        }

        // bit decomposition of L
        int[] bit = new int[20];
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 18; i++) {
            if (((L >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                bit[++n] = 1 << i;
            }
        }
        int len = 1 << n;

        // compute g[i][mask] = inv[sum of bits selected by mask]
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (((i >> (j - 1)) & 1) != 0) {
                    s += bit[j];
                }
            }
            g[cnt[i]][i] = inv[s];
        }

        // compute inverses of small numbers for later polynomial operations
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)(Mo - Mo / i) * inv[Mo % i] % Mo);
        }

        // fwt on each row of g
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            fwt(g[i], len);
        }

        long[] h = new long[20];
        long[] p = new long[20];

        for (int s = 0; s < len; s++) {
            // copy column g[i][s] into h[i]
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = g[i][s];
            }

            // transform from h to p (first part)
            p[0] = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                p[i] = h[i] * i;
                for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                    p[i] -= (p[j] * h[i - j] % Mo) * j;
                }
                p[i] = (p[i] % Mo + Mo) % Mo;
                p[i] = p[i] * inv[i] % Mo;
            }

            // copy p back to h (now h = p)
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = p[i] % Mo;
            }

            // multiply by k
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = h[i] * k % Mo;
            }

            // second part: compute exponential
            p[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                p[i] = 0;
                for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                    p[i] = (p[i] + h[j] * p[i - j] % Mo * j) % Mo;
                }
                p[i] = p[i] * inv[i] % Mo;
            }

            // store result in f[i][s]
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                f[i][s] = (int)p[i];
            }
        }

        // inverse transform on row n
        ifwt(f[n], len);

        long ans = (long)f[n][len - 1] * fac[L] % Mo;
        ans = (all - ans + Mo) % Mo;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
